name: 44143 · Richmond Hts, OH
findings: ZIP 44143 (Richmond Hts) has 148 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44143 (Richmond Hts) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44143 (Richmond Hts) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
